$comment: Shared strictness, extended by each workspace. This file is a BASE, not a project — it
is named tsconfig.base.json so no editor or tool tries to compile it and then reports
apps/api (Node, NodeNext, decorators) and apps/web (Next.js, Bundler resolution, DOM,
JSX) need genuinely different settings; one config cannot serve both honestly. Each
extends this and supplies its own module settings and include globs.
`module` and `moduleResolution` are set here only so they do not fall back to 'classic',
which is incompatible with resolveJsonModule (TS5070). Both workspaces override them.
No `baseUrl` and no `paths`. Cross-package imports resolve through npm workspaces, which
works at runtime as well as at compile time — `paths` is compile-time only, so tsc would
pass while node failed at import. `baseUrl` is also deprecated as of TypeScript 5.5.
